bundle_validation_rules.description: Bundle must contain at least 40 meaningful files
Any blocking EC with status PENDING = INVALID_CLOSURE
final-clean-proof.txt must be captured AFTER the final bundle commit; git status --short must be empty
content-audit-repaired.json must show 42/42 io_authority_matched=true; no PRESENT_NO_AUTHORITY
Any PARTIAL destination entry without explicit partial verdict in final-verdict.md = FAILURE
README audit must check I/O claims, not just size/presence
README gate must be wired into publication flow AND have passing tests
Bundle must include actual validator output log, not hardcoded rules list
todo.md must have no unchecked active [ ] items at closure
Words and Diagram root README version gaps must be classified as policy or actionable
Any active runnable type with input_format=unknown = FAILURE
Test log must exist and show 0 failed
commands.log must not be IN_PROGRESS at closure
